body:
Root cause: main.c unconditionally requested a desktop OpenGL 3.2 Compatibility SDL_GL context (unsupported by Emscripten's WebGL/EGL emulation) and used desktop GLSL 150 shaders (in/out qualifiers, rejected by WebGL1's GLSL ES 1.00 compiler). Both guarded behind #ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__ with WebGL1-compatible equivalents; native/Windows builds unchanged and verified still compiling clean. Verified fix via headless Chromium: SDL_GL_CreateContext now succeeds, zero shader/WebGL errors (vs fatal errors pre-fix), arena match log written normally. Rebuilt and deployed battlegrounds.html/js/wasm to /var/www/okemily/battlegrounds/. GoblinFoxDragon d57ac6c.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed DragonsNShit web player black screen -- SDL GL context + GLSL version mismatch
